run_GetQuickEvalStatsDirScript: run the GetQuickEvalStatsDirScript with a path argument to collect evaluation stats from a directory
setup_args_GetQuickEvalStatsDirScript: setup the argument parser for GetQuickEvalStatsDirScript to accept a required path parameter
extract_eval_metrics: extract ppl, token_em, jga, and jga variants from eval_stats.json files in a directory
aggregate_multi_eval_stats: aggregate metrics from eval_stats, user_eval_stats, in_eval_stats, and test_eval_stats files into CSV output
parse_model_opt_and_run_sh: parse model.opt and run.sh files to extract learning rate, multitask weights, and base model info
